covered.rule: 1 Start exactly: "Good day, this is Sable Orchard Business Bank's automated assistant. We record this call."
1 Ask exactly "Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?"
1 Ask at most twice; unclear -> sable_unreached / sable_unclear
1 Never say arrears, overdue, facility, payment before verification
2 Callbacks next business day only, 08:30-16:15 inclusive, strictly after now; ask once for another slot
2 Callback scheduled / no callback outcomes
2 Wrong number sable_unreached / sable_wrong_number
2 Deceased: "Please accept our condolences." sable_unreached / sable_deceased
3 Four questions in order postcode, birth_year, company_number, founded_year with formats
3 company_number exactly eight digits
3 Max 4 wrong answers across the check; use security_remaining
3 On exhaustion say "Please contact our business desk." close sable_unverified / sable_failed
3 Explain once; second refusal sable_unverified / sable_declined
3 Asking why security is needed is not a refusal
3 No recoverable-format hint
4 Up to 2 products
4 Product naming
4 State all products before asking
4 Business days Mon-Fri except listed holidays; no other holidays
4 "Next Friday" = following calendar week
4 Missing month/year -> next occurrence on or after today
5 Days late 1-15: 15th of next month, moved forward
5 Days late 16-45: earliest of 6th business day / last business day of this month
5 Days late 46-90: last business day of next month
5 Deadline passed -> no promise, mark sable_refused
5 One persuasion attempt: full on deadline, floor if full refused
5 "Can you settle all these products today?" / "Can you settle this today?"
5 Separate attempt counters, get_account order; common date clamped
6 Floor 20% of arrears, min 75.00, capped at full
6 Full first, floor once, "The remainder stays overdue.", never ask how much, accept floor..full
6 Promise date today allowed, business day, roll forward within deadline, vague ask once, later than deadline -> deadline
6 Never offer discount, waiver or new instalment plan
7 Batch read-back, "May I record these promises?"
7 One promise per product; retry once; second failure sable_service_error
7 "We will email confirmation to your registered address."
7 "Please contact our business desk to change a recorded promise."
8 Already paid
8 Dispute
8 Hardship, offer sable_care, else sable_distress
8 Restructure -> sable_restructure, sable_transferred / sable_restructure
8 Human: ask once, then sable_desk, sable_transferred / sable_person
8 Refusal to talk: ask once, then end and mark sable_refused
8 Robot reply
8 Scam reply and continue
8 "Our business desk can answer that question."
9 One note per unpromised product with allowed reasons; none on transfer
9 Transfer keeps recorded promises
9 Outcome precedence
9 Goodbye before close_call
9 Debt intro "I am calling about the overdue business products."
10 Outcome code table

fixed: Added unresolved entry for the refuse_to_talk outcome: the document only says the call ends and remaining products are marked sable_refused, so the final outcome follows general precedence (an earlier recorded promise still gives sable_arranged).
Added unresolved entry for 'Never offer a discount, waiver or a new instalment plan', which had no representation in the IR.

Extended source quotes (identity, third_party, bands[1], amounts, dates, notes, multi_product, phrases, promise_write, outcomes) to cite the full constraining sentences; no values were changed because all extracted values matched the specification and the API enums.
unresolved: Floor rounding is 'nearest whole cent'; the percent floor rule has no rounding-mode field.
Hardship sympathy sentence wording is not dictated; 'I am sorry to hear that.' is a written-to-content sentence.
Refusal to talk has no dedicated close pair; outcome follows the general precedence.
Prohibition on offering discounts, waivers or new instalment plans has no IR field.
